Name: Recipes In Mail
Author: Freaksaus
Description:
A pretty simple and straightforward mod. Every time you forget to watch the Queen of Sauce you will receive a mail in your mailbox the following monday. Read it and you will still get the recipe!

[b]Compatibility[/b]
The recipe data is loaded from the data files so any mods that change the Queen of Sauce recipes should be compatible. If you do find any issues please let me know.

[b]Source code
[/b]You can find the source code over on [url=https://github.com/Freaksaus/RecipesInMail]github[/url]

Downloads.Description: Queen of Sauce recipes are now loaded through the game files
